fullApplication.durationScope: Actual Node suite duration; not inferred process wall time.
fullApplication.executionScope: Complete actual application suite in one formal isolated frozen stage phase. No checkout application/install/device acceptance.

sourcePhases.scope: One formal frozen source phase for core, UI, host, portable and all actual browser/full application proofs. No earlier-topic error/phase is transplanted into this round.

earlierFocusedUi.durationScope: Actual Node suite duration; not inferred process wall time.
earlierFocusedUi.scope: A passing earlier fixture/i18n focus; its exact count above is not relabelled as the later complete combined regression.

webRetainedAttempts.scope: Initial forty injected new GUI cases plus three catalogue cases. Fresh native integration and old distribution regression are not claimed in this early run; the final82 includes them.

overlap: Focused/core/UI/host/module checks overlap the complete application and each other. Native, prepared and browser prove different boundaries; counts are not additive coverage.
